name: badge-variants
title: Badge: Variants
description: Use the `variant` prop to change the variant of the badge.

files.content:
import { Badge } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/badge"; const Example = () => (
{( [ "default", "secondary", "info", "success", "warning", "error", "ghost-error", "ghost-success", "ghost-warning", "ghost-info", "tag-gray", "tag-red", "tag-orange", "tag-yellow", "tag-green", "tag-cyan", "tag-blue", "tag-purple", "tag-magenta", "outline", ] as const ).map((variant) => ( {variant} ))}
); export default Example;
